title: Homilies on Joshua, Homily 9
blurb: Origen’s Homily 9 on Joshua (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–4.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homily 9 on Joshua — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Bruce FOTC 105 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homily 9 §§1–4 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VII (GCS 30, 1921), Rufinus’s Latin of Homily 9. Bruce FOTC 105 was not used as wording. This page is Homily 9 §§1–4 (closeout).
